item.description:
Release v5.10.0

Changes since v5.9.0

  • document: update documentation
  • feat: add AboutView for all non-disabled plugins missing one
  • feat(app-store-connect): enable chat visibility for the plugin
  • feat(AppStoreConnectPlugin): add ReadAppStoreConnectLocalizationTool
  • feat(AppStoreConnectPlugin): add ReadAppStoreConnectVersionTool
  • feat(AppStoreConnectPlugin): support partial localization updates
  • feat(LumiUI): add selection state localization strings
  • fix(aliyun): restore registered tool names after sanitize round-trip
  • fix(app-store-connect): correct docs to match official App Store Connect API
  • fix(AppManagerPlugin): align cache database path with project storage convention
  • fix(build): remove quotes around SWIFT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL in xcconfig
  • fix(build): resolve automatic signing conflict in xcconfig
  • fix(LLMKit): restore sanitized tool names via reverseMap
  • fix(LumiApp): add missing import LumiKernel for LumiPlugin type
  • fix(version): restore Lumi 5.9.0 / build 602 after dev merge
  • refactor(app-store-connect): adopt LumiUI across views and add missing components
  • refactor(AppStoreConnect): adjust sidebar icon size and spacing
  • refactor(AppStoreConnect): redesign rail view layout with inline app list and version picker
  • refactor(AppStoreConnect): use AppListRow component from LumiUI
  • refactor(build): migrate build settings from pbxproj to xcconfig
